title: [finding] `@objectstack/spec`'s DTS pass hit its 6144 MB heap ceiling in CI (`ERR_WORKER_OUT_OF_MEMORY`, Test Core 6/6) on a PR whose diff adds nothing to that pass
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, finding class **(b)**. The spec build's DTS pass declares a heap ceiling that its own docblock says must hold, and on CI it did not hold. `reach:` was measured on one CI run, below. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01ARcDurZ5j34RdqsGgc4jgH`, seat post #18917) while reviewing PR #20415. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happened (measured)

- PR #20415 (#20126), head `7fc9f86b`. `Test Core (6/6)`, job `108869603141` (run `36404384622`), 2026-09-28T09:36–09:38Z. The step `@objectstack/spec:build` finished its ESM and CJS passes, started `DTS Build start`, and 114 s later printed:
  ```
  Error [ERR_WORKER_OUT_OF_MEMORY]: Worker terminated due to reaching memory limit: JS heap out of memory
  ```
  It exited 1, so the shard ran no test body.
- **The PR's diff is outside that pass.** Its four files are:
  - `packages/spec/src/data/currency-mode-family-closure.pin.test.ts`, which `packages/spec/tsconfig.json` excludes (`"exclude": [..., "**/*.test.ts"]`);
  - `packages/spec/vitest.repo-tests.json`;
  - `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs`;
  - `turbo.json`.
  None of them enters the declaration program.
- **Controls on the same base:**
  - `main` at `40b315b0`: `Test Core (6/6)` success.
  - PR #20344 at `b30325bb`, a merge of `40b315b0`: all 33 checks success, shard 6 included.
  - `7db1332f`, `65352b7d` and `34ec30d4`: shard 6 success.

  So the ceiling is not exceeded on every run. It is exceeded on some runs over essentially the same declaration graph: the pass now sits at the ceiling.

## Why it matters

- `packages/spec/tsup.config.ts` (the DTS-pass docblock) says: 「If this pass starts failing with `ERR_WORKER_OUT_OF_MEMORY`, the live type graph has outgrown 6144 — that is a loud, actionable failure and the point of the ceiling. ⛔ Do not "fix" it by raising the number past what the build container has; that trades this error back for the silent exit 137. Shrink the graph, or split the pass across entries.」
- Its measured table (peak RSS 5794 MB at the 6144 ceiling; 4096 fails) predates the growth since. The spec graph keeps growing with every retirement tombstone and schema.
- A random red `Test Core` blocks enqueue for whichever PR draws it. A seat cannot re-run a job (the fleet relay has no re-run op), so the PR sits red until a human re-runs it or an unrelated push re-triggers CI.
- Predecessor: #4845, closed. It was the same pass against the runner's memory at a 12288 ceiling; the 6144 ceiling and the docblock came from it.

## Where the fix lands (for the dispatch to confirm)

- `packages/spec/tsup.config.ts`, the DTS pass: split it across entries as the docblock prescribes, or shrink the graph. First re-measure the peak on today's `main` in an 8 GB cgroup, as the docblock's table did, so that "at the ceiling" is a number.
- ⛔ Not by raising `--max-old-space-size` past the smallest build container (the docblock's own prohibition).

Dedupe: #4845 (closed, the 12288 episode) is the only prior hit for `ERR_WORKER_OUT_OF_MEMORY` / spec DTS heap. #17708 and #14569 are `tsc` heap ceilings on other gates.

Dedupe words: `spec DTS pass ERR_WORKER_OUT_OF_MEMORY 6144` · `tsup dts heap ceiling Test Core 6/6 OOM` · `spec build out of memory CI shard`
